
::::

## About

The table collects **metadata** only – it links to the data providers but does not host any data.
Each row is one parameter (variable) of a dataset. *Spatial res.* and *Temporal res.* show the finest – coarsest available resolution;
the resolution filters keep a row if its *finest* resolution is at least as fine as the selected value.
Rows with unknown values are never filtered out by the resolution filters.

**Contribute a dataset:** open a [new-dataset issue](https://github.com/MxNl/awesome_geodata_table/issues/new?template=new-dataset.yml)
or edit [`metadata/datasets.csv`](https://github.com/MxNl/awesome_geodata_table/blob/main/metadata/datasets.csv) and
[`metadata/parameters.csv`](https://github.com/MxNl/awesome_geodata_table/blob/main/metadata/parameters.csv) in a pull request.
The raw metadata can be downloaded as [datasets.csv](metadata/datasets.csv) and [parameters.csv](metadata/parameters.csv).
